title: Veterans’ Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act of 2025
official_summary:
Veterans' Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act of 2025

This act requires the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) to increase the amounts payable for wartime disability compensation, additional compensation for dependents, the clothing allowance for certain disabled veterans, and dependency and indemnity compensation for surviving spouses and children. Specifically, the VA must increase the amounts by the same percentage as the cost-of-living increase in benefits for Social Security recipients that is effective on December 1, 2025. The act requires the VA to publish the amounts payable, as increased, in the Federal Register.

The VA is authorized to make a similar adjustment to the rates of disability compensation payable to persons who have not received compensation for service-connected disability or death.

summary.headline: Raises VA disability and survivor payments by the same percentage as the Social Security cost-of-living increase starting December 1, 2025.
summary.what_it_does: The law requires the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) to raise several benefit payments by the same percentage as the Social Security cost-of-living increase that takes effect December 1, 2025. This covers disability compensation, extra payments for dependents, the clothing allowance for certain disabled veterans, and payments to surviving spouses and children. The VA must publish the new amounts in the Federal Register. The VA may also make a similar increase for certain other people whose disability payments are not paid under the main compensation rules.

who_it_affects.how: Their monthly disability compensation goes up by the same percentage as the Social Security cost-of-living increase.

who_it_affects.group: Disabled veterans with spouses, children, or other dependents
who_it_affects.how: The extra amount they get for dependents also increases by the same percentage.

who_it_affects.group: Disabled veterans who qualify for the clothing allowance
who_it_affects.how: Their clothing allowance, paid because their disability or medical equipment wears out clothing, goes up.

who_it_affects.group: Surviving spouses and children of service members or veterans
who_it_affects.how: Their dependency and indemnity compensation payments increase by the same percentage.

who_it_affects.group: Certain people receiving disability payments under other VA rules
who_it_affects.how: The VA is allowed, but not required, to give them a similar increase.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The increase applies starting December 1, 2025, matching the Social Security cost-of-living increase.
